name: Unidentified rebel capital ship
description: A capital ship of the Alliance to Restore the Republic's fleet was destroyed in the Altyr system of the Outer Rim's Morshdine sector in 3 ABY during a battle against the Galactic Empire's Imperial Navy as part of the Galactic Civil War. The battle in which the capital ship was destroyed was called a brisk reminder of the Empire's superior force by Commander Folimar, who was quoted by reporter Dorna Parros during a HoloNet News broadcast covering the battle.
